selected_skill.selection_reason: Exercise lookup, macro-aware food selection, and plan delivery map directly to a strength split plus repeatable meal plan task.

safe_use_screening.notes: The task uses task-local catalogs shaped by public exercise and nutrition sources. It avoids private workspace access, wearable sync, and clinical-style personal data.

real_data_design.source_type: public exercise and nutrition references with task-local normalization
real_data_design.normalization_strategy: Use public exercise and nutrition field shapes as the semantic basis, then add task-local member constraints, shortlist drift, and deterministic planning templates in local files.
real_data_design.determinism: All authoritative inputs live inside the task so the verifier can recompute the expected workout plan, meal plan, and summary without network access.

environment_design.with_without_control: with_skill and without_skill differ only by whether environment/skills is present in the runtime copy and copied into the agent skill path.

goals: State the delivery contract and current-input rule clearly.
Keep the output structure explicit while leaving the planning workflow mostly implicit.
Keep the final source instruction free of skill-specific prompts.
Make older shortlists tempting but insufficient.
hidden_workflow_pressure: Current catalogs contain must-use items that do not appear in the older shortlist exports.
Unavailable equipment and blocked foods in the older shortlists lead to action-level mistakes if the solver trusts them.
Meal totals and weekly set totals must line up across all required outputs.

main_tests: required output files exist and parse
workout plan satisfies current catalog constraints, day templates, and equipment limits
meal plan rows use current allowed foods and correct serving-based macro calculations
summary totals, coverage flags, and weekly set totals recompute from the current outputs and current inputs
coach handoff contains required sections and calls out shortlist changes
guardrails: current-only exercise IDs must appear in the final workout plan
stale or blocked exercise and food IDs must not appear in outputs
macro totals and weekly set totals must match authoritative calculations
verifier_design.failure_target: without_skill should fail for action-level reasons such as using stale shortlist items, missing current-only exercise and food IDs, or miscomputing meal totals.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every cloud trial must use a new isolated runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.oracle_rule: Do not finalize README until oracle and comparison trials are available.
experiment_protocol.comparison_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills presence and corresponding copy behavior.
experiment_protocol.debug_copy_note: Comparison-copy debugging may include a local-guide hint, but the final template source stays hint-free.
